summary:
Unity Global Trading Sdn. Bhd., incorporated in Selangor on June 15, 2018, operates as a private limited company within the retail sector, specifically focusing on textiles and baju kurung. The business is owned by five individual directors who collectively hold all shares; Director 4 holds the largest stake at 58.25%, followed by Executive Director (Director 5) with 21.22%.

Financial data covers fiscal years ending June 30, 2022 through 2024. Revenue grew from RM5.13 million in FY2022 to RM5.35 million in FY2024. Net profit after tax was RM96,805 in FY2024 compared to RM113,910 in FY2022. Operating cash flow fluctuated significantly, dropping from RM228,345 in FY2023 to RM113,617 in FY2024. Free cash flow turned negative across all three years reported, reaching -RM239,509 in FY2024 due to capital expenditures exceeding operating inflows. All audits received unqualified opinions from Audit Firm 8.

No court cases are listed in the supplied record for this entity. However, reliance on a single audit firm across multiple years warrants verification of independence and scope. The consistent negative free cash flow despite revenue growth requires investigation into working capital management efficiency. Further review should confirm if current director appointments align with governance standards and validate the sustainability of operating margins given rising expense ratios in FY2024.
